purpose: Verify authorized user can access course workspace and view course home with syllabus, schedule, instructors, and TAs
preconditions: Course C101 exists with syllabus, schedule, instructor, and TA configured; user is enrolled student or assigned faculty/TA
action_or_input: Authorized user requests to open course workspace for C101
expected_result: System validates course access and returns course workspace details including syllabus, schedule, instructors, and TAs with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify system denies course workspace access when user is not authorized for the selected course
preconditions: Course C101 exists; user U1 is not enrolled, assigned, or linked to C101
action_or_input: User U1 requests to access course workspace for C101
expected_result: System denies access with HTTP 403 or 404; no workspace details are disclosed

purpose: Verify workspace access is not exposed when registration or association link data is absent
preconditions: User has valid login credentials but no course registration or membership record in the system
action_or_input: User attempts to access C101 workspace
expected_result: System cannot confirm course access and rejects request without exposing workspace content

purpose: Verify assigned Faculty can configure course workspace details and save changes
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 updates course syllabus, description, and office hours for C101
expected_result: System verifies Faculty authorization, stores updated details, and returns updated course details with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify assigned Faculty can edit previously published course details
preconditions: Course C101 has existing published details; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 modifies existing syllabus and schedule
expected_result: System persists modified details and presents new values on course home

purpose: Verify unauthorized user or non-assigned faculty cannot modify course details
preconditions: Course C101 exists; User U2 is either student, TA, or faculty not assigned to C101
action_or_input: User U2 attempts to update course details for C101
expected_result: System rejects update with HTTP 403; existing course details remain unchanged

purpose: Verify assigned Faculty can add course material with immediate publication
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 uploads file or link material with title, module section, and immediate publication flag
expected_result: System validates input, saves material in Published state, and returns HTTP 201

purpose: Verify assigned Faculty can add course material with future release date
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 adds material specifying a future release timestamp
expected_result: System validates input, saves material in Scheduled state, and returns HTTP 201

purpose: Verify assigned Faculty can edit and reorganize existing course material
preconditions: Material M1 exists in C101; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 updates material M1 title, description, and display order
expected_result: System saves modifications and reflects updated metadata with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify TA, Student, or Observer write attempts on course materials are rejected
preconditions: User is a TA, Student, or Observer in course C101
action_or_input: User attempts to create, update, or delete course material in C101
expected_result: System rejects write attempt with HTTP 403; no material changes are committed

purpose: Verify authorized Student, TA, or Observer can list and view published course materials in read-only form
preconditions: Material M1 in C101 is Published; user is enrolled Student, TA, or linked Observer
action_or_input: User requests materials list or material details for M1
expected_result: System returns published material in read-only form with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify scheduled or unpublished course material is omitted from student and observer material views until released
preconditions: Material M2 in C101 has Scheduled state (future release timestamp); student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 requests course materials list or material details for M2
expected_result: Scheduled material M2 is omitted from the list; direct request returns HTTP 403 or 404

purpose: Verify user not enrolled or linked to the course is denied access to view published materials
preconditions: Material M1 is published in C101; user U3 is not member of C101
action_or_input: User U3 requests to view materials for C101
expected_result: System denies access with HTTP 403 or 404

purpose: Verify assigned Faculty can post course announcement with automatic timestamp and course-wide visibility
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 posts announcement with title and content
expected_result: System records announcement with author attribution and timestamp, returns HTTP 201

purpose: Verify TA permitted to post announcements can successfully post course announcement
preconditions: TA T1 is assigned to course C101 and granted announcement posting permission
action_or_input: TA T1 posts announcement with title and content
expected_result: System verifies TA posting authority, records announcement with timestamp, and returns HTTP 201

purpose: Verify unauthorized user, Student, Observer, or TA without posting permission is rejected when attempting to post announcement
preconditions: TA T2 in C101 lacks announcement permission, or user S1 is a Student
action_or_input: User attempts to post announcement to C101
expected_result: System rejects posting attempt with HTTP 403; no announcement is created

purpose: Verify authorized course members can retrieve and view timestamped course announcements
preconditions: Course C101 has announcements posted; user is enrolled student, assigned faculty, TA, or linked observer
action_or_input: Authorized user requests announcements for C101
expected_result: System returns announcements list with timestamps and author details with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify unauthorized user cannot view course announcements
preconditions: User U3 is not affiliated with course C101
action_or_input: User U3 requests announcements for C101
expected_result: System refuses access with HTTP 403 or 404; no announcements exposed

purpose: Verify assigned Faculty can create new assignment with title, due date, instructions, submission type, and points, saving in Draft state
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 creates assignment providing title, instructions, submission_type='file', points_possible=100, and valid due_date
expected_result: System validates configuration, saves assignment in Draft state, and returns HTTP 201

purpose: Verify assigned Faculty can edit existing Draft assignment
preconditions: Assignment A1 in C101 is in Draft state; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 updates title, instructions, or points possible for A1
expected_result: System validates and saves modifications while preserving Draft state; returns HTTP 200

purpose: Verify TA, Student, or Observer assignment-authoring attempts are rejected
preconditions: User is a TA, Student, or Observer in C101
action_or_input: User attempts to create or update an assignment in C101
expected_result: System rejects request with HTTP 403; assignment is not created or modified

purpose: Verify assigned Faculty can publish Draft assignment for immediate release, making it Published and Available to students
preconditions: Assignment A1 in C101 is valid Draft with release_at=None or release_at in the past; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 requests publication of assignment A1
expected_result: System transitions assignment to Published/Available state; returns HTTP 200

purpose: Verify assigned Faculty can publish Draft assignment with future release date, marking it Published and Scheduled for Release
preconditions: Assignment A2 in C101 is valid Draft with future release_at timestamp; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 requests publication of assignment A2
expected_result: System transitions assignment to Scheduled state; returns HTTP 200; content remains unreleased to students

purpose: Verify incomplete or invalid Draft assignment cannot be published
preconditions: Assignment A3 in C101 is missing due_date or has invalid points possible; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 attempts to publish assignment A3
expected_result: System rejects publication with HTTP 400 or 422; assignment remains in Draft state

purpose: Verify enrolled Student can view and download details of published and released assignment
preconditions: Assignment A1 in C101 is Published and Available; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 requests assignment details for A1
expected_result: System returns assignment details, instructions, due date, and points possible with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify future-dated unreleased assignment is hidden from enrolled Students
preconditions: Assignment A2 in C101 is Published but Scheduled (future release_at); Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 lists assignments or requests details for A2
expected_result: Assignment A2 is omitted from student view; direct request returns HTTP 403 or 404

purpose: Verify user not enrolled in course is denied access to view published assignment
preconditions: Assignment A1 is published in C101; user U4 is not enrolled in C101
action_or_input: User U4 requests details for assignment A1
expected_result: System denies access with HTTP 403 or 404

purpose: Verify enrolled Student can submit assignment conforming to configured submission type before due date
preconditions: Assignment A1 is Available with submission_type='text' and future due date; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 submits text content for assignment A1
expected_result: System validates type and timing, records submission with timestamp and student identity, returns HTTP 201

purpose: Verify submission with a type inconsistent with assignment configuration is rejected
preconditions: Assignment A1 requires submission_type='file'; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 attempts to submit raw text instead of file upload
expected_result: System rejects submission with HTTP 400 or 422; no submission is recorded

purpose: Verify non-enrolled user or faculty/TA cannot submit assignment as a student
preconditions: User U5 is not an enrolled student in course C101
action_or_input: User U5 attempts to submit to assignment A1
expected_result: System rejects submission attempt with HTTP 403

purpose: Verify enrolled Student can view their own assignment submission history and status
preconditions: Student S1 has submitted work for assignment A1 in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 requests submission history for assignment A1
expected_result: System returns Student S1's own submission records, status, and timestamps with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify submission status reflects submitted, missing, or evaluated accurately
preconditions: Student S2 is enrolled in C101 but has not submitted assignment A1
action_or_input: Student S2 queries submission status for assignment A1
expected_result: System returns status indicating not submitted / missing with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify Student is denied access to view another Student's submission data
preconditions: Student S1 has submitted work for A1; Student S2 is another enrolled student
action_or_input: Student S2 requests submission history or details of Student S1
expected_result: System denies access with HTTP 403 or 404; no other student submission is exposed

purpose: Verify assigned Faculty can grade a student submission, recording points and feedback in Draft state with actor attribution
preconditions: Submission Sub1 exists for assignment A1 in C101; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 enters points=85 and feedback='Good analysis' for Sub1
expected_result: System validates points, records grade in Draft state with grader attribution and timestamp, returns HTTP 200 or 201

purpose: Verify course TA can grade a student submission, recording points and feedback in Draft state
preconditions: Submission Sub1 exists in C101; TA T1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: TA T1 enters points=90 and feedback='Well done' for Sub1
expected_result: System records Draft grade attributed to TA T1 with HTTP 200 or 201

purpose: Verify modifying an already released grade generates an audit record capturing actor and timestamp
preconditions: Grade G1 for Sub1 is in Released state; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 updates grade G1 points from 85 to 90 with justification
expected_result: System updates grade and creates audit trail record containing actor, previous points, new points, and timestamp

purpose: Verify unauthorized user or non-course grader is rejected when attempting to grade submission
preconditions: User U6 is a Student, Observer, or faculty not assigned to C101
action_or_input: User U6 attempts to enter or update grade for Sub1
expected_result: System rejects grading request with HTTP 403; grade remains unchanged

purpose: Verify conflict-of-interest check prevents an actor from grading their own submission
preconditions: User is both an enrolled student who submitted work and has TA role in the course
action_or_input: User attempts to grade their own submission
expected_result: System rejects self-grading with HTTP 403 or 422 (CANNOT_GRADE_OWN_SUBMISSION)

purpose: Verify assigned Faculty can release draft grades and feedback to Students
preconditions: Draft grades exist for assignment A1 in C101; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 initiates release of draft grades for A1
expected_result: System transitions grades from Draft to Released, making them visible to students; returns HTTP 200

purpose: Verify TA cannot perform grade release under baseline specification
preconditions: Draft grades exist in C101; TA T1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: TA T1 attempts to trigger grade release for assignment A1
expected_result: System denies grade release action with HTTP 403; draft grades remain unreleased

purpose: Verify enrolled Student can view their own released grade and feedback in read-only form
preconditions: Grade for Student S1's submission has been Released; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 requests their grade for assignment A1
expected_result: System returns released points, maximum points, and feedback in read-only form with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify draft or unreleased grade is hidden from the Student
preconditions: Grade for Student S1's submission is in Draft state
action_or_input: Student S1 requests their grade for assignment A1
expected_result: System does not expose draft grade; returns unreleased / pending evaluation status

purpose: Verify Student is denied access to view another Student's released grade and feedback
preconditions: Grade for Student S1 is released; Student S2 is another enrolled student
action_or_input: Student S2 attempts to view grade of Student S1
expected_result: System refuses access with HTTP 403 or 404; no grade data disclosed

purpose: Verify scheduled course material is transitioned to Published/Available when configured release timestamp is reached
preconditions: Material M1 in C101 is in Scheduled state with release timestamp T_rel; current time >= T_rel
action_or_input: System executes scheduled release task for materials
expected_result: System verifies eligibility, transitions M1 state to Published, making it visible to students

purpose: Verify scheduled assignment is transitioned to Available for submission when configured release timestamp is reached
preconditions: Assignment A2 in C101 is in Scheduled state with release_at <= current time
action_or_input: System executes scheduled release task for assignments
expected_result: System transitions A2 state to Available, enabling student viewing and submission

purpose: Verify withdrawn or unpublished scheduled content is not released when scheduled time arrives
preconditions: Material M2 was scheduled but then withdrawn or deleted by Faculty before release time
action_or_input: Release task runs at release timestamp
expected_result: System detects content is no longer eligible; no release occurs

purpose: Verify content release failure keeps content unavailable without partial exposure
preconditions: Scheduled content cannot be released due to system constraint or invalid state
action_or_input: System release execution encounters exception
expected_result: Content remains unavailable to students and operational log is recorded
